r.경제 체제: Economy reliant on its petroleum fund
r.Consumer price level: 45% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.주요 수출품: Crude oil 67%, Aircraft, spacecraft 12%, Coffee 10%, Machinery, computers 4%, Ships 3% (2023, share of all exports, top 5)
r.한국이 파는 것: Beverages 76%, Furniture, lighting 12%, Precision and medical instruments 3%, Other textile goods 2% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Coffee 92%, Chipmaking equipment 5% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: Power is shared between the president and the prime minister, and the independence-struggle generation has led politics.

t.why: It joined ASEAN as its 11th member in 2025. Offshore gas fields are its main source of income.
t.rel: It became independent in 2002 after Indonesia's occupation ended and a period of UN transitional administration. It disputed sea boundaries and gas fields with Australia until a 2018 treaty settled them, and became ASEAN's 11th member in 2025.
t.know: Major violence followed the 1999 independence vote, and Korea sent peacekeepers, the Evergreen unit.
t.etext: It runs its budget from a fund that holds income from offshore oil and gas. As the gas fields deplete, it needs other sources of income. It joined ASEAN in 2025.
